description: Starter registry of appellate courts and the Colorado Attorney General's Office associated with the Ralph L. Carr Judicial Center.

institutions.name: Colorado Supreme Court
institutions.notes: Colorado's court of last resort, located at the Ralph L. Carr Judicial Center.

institutions.name: Colorado Court of Appeals
institutions.notes: Colorado's intermediate appellate court; public oral arguments are held at the Ralph L. Carr Judicial Center unless remote proceedings are ordered.

institutions.name: Colorado Attorney General / Department of Law
institutions.notes: The Attorney General's official page identifies the office at the Ralph L. Carr Colorado Judicial Center, 1300 Broadway, Denver. Its executive-branch legal functions are distinct from the courts sharing the campus.
